title: Billing and Coding: Autonomic Function Tests

covered.1: The following ICD-10-CM codes support medical necessity and provide limited coverage for CPT codes: 95921, 95922, 95923, and 95924 It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted.

noncovered.1: All those not listed under the “ICD-10 Codes that Support Medical Necessity” section of this article.
